summary: Build a daily news brief in the background while you use other apps.
release_notes: Rebuilt on a renderer that keeps every control reachable at the largest text sizes, and on a keyboard that can type every character this app asks for.
user: Somebody who wants the day's news in one quiet read.
job: Build a daily news brief in the background while you use other apps.
offline: Briefs already built read without the network; building today's needs it.

data.location: the app's private storage on the reader
data.export: not offered; yesterday's news is yesterday's news

capabilities_required.name: network
capabilities_required.purpose: to fetch the day's stories for your brief

non_goals: It does not replace a full news reader.
It does not alert you; the brief waits for you.
